assurance.contrast.luminance.message: CONTRAST-COLOR: Source calculation requires an opaque six-digit sRGB colour.

evidence: Foreground and opaque surface are explicitly paired by the authored reading-theme rule.
The light reading theme lacks a matching complete foreground/background component rule. The legacy masthead/footer surface can survive while text inherits the reading palette.

value.method: Admitted algebra evaluates authored component bindings and the WCAG sRGB luminance formula. Source evidence, not computed browser colours.
value.boundary: Bounded to the shared reading-page masthead, footer and essay title surface. Selector coverage is a declared component contract, not a general CSS cascade interpreter. Gradients, hover/focus states, arbitrary templates and actual rendered colours still require browser observation.

value.method: Compare the original capture bindings with the current generated artifact hashes. A shared dependency change conservatively invalidates current-layout claims across the inventory.
